form.label: Follow-up queue
form.description: Enterprise Security findings scored with Triage agent enrichment. Use Demo data to explore without ES, or ES API to read live findings.

search.query: | loadfindings mode=$mode$ limit=$limit$ | where "$decision$"="*" OR investigation_required="$decision$" | stats count(eval(investigation_required="Yes")) as count
| loadfindings mode=$mode$ limit=$limit$ | where "$decision$"="*" OR investigation_required="$decision$" | stats count(eval(investigation_required="Review")) as count
| loadfindings mode=$mode$ limit=$limit$ | where "$decision$"="*" OR investigation_required="$decision$" | stats count(eval(investigation_required="No")) as count
| loadfindings mode=$mode$ limit=$limit$ | where "$decision$"="*" OR investigation_required="$decision$" | stats avg(followup_score) as score | eval score=round(score,1)

| loadfindings mode=$mode$ limit=$limit$ | where "$decision$"="*" OR investigation_required="$decision$" | eval bucket=case(followup_score<30,"0-29",followup_score<50,"30-49",followup_score<75,"50-74",true(),"75-100") | stats count by bucket | sort bucket

| loadfindings mode=$mode$ limit=$limit$ | where "$decision$"="*" OR investigation_required="$decision$" | eval triage_disposition=if(triage_present=0,"not_run",triage_disposition) | stats count by triage_disposition

table.title: Scored findings — click a row to open the workbench

search.query: | loadfindings mode=$mode$ limit=$limit$ | where "$decision$"="*" OR investigation_required="$decision$" | sort - followup_score | table followup_score, investigation_required, finding_id, title, urgency, triage_disposition, triage_confidence, evidence_net_weight, recommended_search_count, owner, status, user, src, dest
